method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05; the dates in one module, the rules and exported questions in another, the cases in a third; two regulative rules (ss 215, 256) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Federal Circuit and Family Court of Australia Act 2021 (Cth), Compilation No. 12, compilation date 10 June 2025 (register id C2025C00376), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2021A00012.txt. The Rules of Court and regulations that set the judgment interest rate (s 212(3)(a)), the review period (s 256(1)(a)) and prescribed judgments (s 28(1)(b)) are not deposited and are inputs.

seat: the party bringing (or answering) a civil claim in the Federal Circuit and Family Court of Australia (Division 2): usually the applicant claiming money, damages or other relief, and the same person as appellant, as the person whose information may be suppressed, as the subject of a vexatious proceedings application, or as the party affected by a Registrar's decision (fcfca-claims.l4)

checks.result: 176 assertions written, 176 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: Focus: courts, procedure, time limits, damages (interest) and costs, as a claimant meets them. In: s 7 (definitions used); ss 26(1)(c), (h), (2)(b), 28(1), 50, 55(1)-(3), (6); ss 131(3), 132 (as the family law test), 133(1), 135, 136, 137(1), 143, 149(4), 153(6), 155, 156, 161, 168, 169, 170(1), (3), 172, 173(4), 176, 185, 190(1), 191, 191A, 192(3)-(4), 211, 212, 213, 214, 215, 228-234, 236, 237, 239, 241-244, 256(1)-(2). Out: the constitution of the courts, judges and administration (Chapter 2, Chapter 4 Parts 1 and 9 except s 256, Chapter 5); Division 1 practice (ss 29-49, 51-54, 56-76 bar those listed); court powers not conditioned on the claimant (ss 134, 138-142); transfers between the Divisions and to the Federal Court apart from the appeal bars (ss 149(1)-(3), (5), 150, 153(1)-(5)); an order in the terms of an arbitration award (s 173(1)-(3)); the exception for court officials (s 235) and the saving of other powers over vexatious proceedings (s 238); dispute resolution duties of officials and lawyers and Rules-made procedure (ss 157-160, 162-167, 171); practice, representation, documents, evidence and video links (ss 174-175, 177-184, 186-189, 193-210); Rules and officers (ss 216-227, 240, 245-285).
